subject: COMPUTER
description: ICSE 10th Computer Applications: Classes, Objects, Primitive Types, Operators, Conditionals and Loops

questions.question: Which OOP concept wraps code and data together into a single unit to protect against unauthorized access?
questions.explanation: Encapsulation binds data and member methods into a class and restricts direct access using access specifiers.

questions.question: What is the default initial value of an uninitialized instance variable of boolean type in Java?
questions.explanation: In Java, instance boolean variables default to false automatically.

questions.question: What is the return type of the expression: (15 > 7) && (4 == 4)?
questions.explanation: Logical and relational operators always evaluate to a boolean value (true or false).

questions.question: What is the output of Math.round(7.5) and Math.ceil(7.2) in Java?
questions.explanation: Math.round(7.5) rounds up to long 8, while Math.ceil(7.2) yields double 8.0.

questions.question: Which keyword is used to terminate a loop or switch-case statement immediately in Java?
questions.explanation: The 'break' keyword halts execution of the innermost loop or switch structure immediately.
